Dockweiler, S. and Vang, C.L. (2026). Technology review on non-road machinery (Tech Review - Non-road machinery in agriculture and construction). Danish Energy Agency, Copenhagen, August 2026. ISBN 978-87-94447-52-2. Version 202608A. https://ens.dk/analyser-og-statistik/teknologikataloger

A technology REVIEW, not a catalogue: no data sheets, mostly qualitative, and the source states it relies mainly on secondary sources, so nearly every number is reprinted (flagged in notes). Page numbers are printed page numbers, which equal PDF page numbers. Loaded (main file): engine/motor/fuel-cell/H2-ICE efficiencies (Sect. 2), tractor and excavator system efficiencies (final to useful energy), diesel construction capex 1400 EUR2025/kW, agricultural diesel capex DKK/kW by machine type and size class (Table 9, one row per size class with a leading [size] case marker), BEV abatement cost (EUR2025/t CO2), TRLs per construction size segment and for hydrogen machines, state-of-development for HVO, ag BEV, methane and hydrogen, methane CO2/N2O reduction vs diesel. Not loaded (_other-values): BEV capex premiums and opex changes vs diesel by segment (Tables 6, 13), infrastructure cost premiums, battery container/charger costs, battery capacity/operating hours/charging time (Table 5), ag BEV machine prices (Table 17, absolute DKK per machine, size class only, no price year), HVO price premium, energy-use shares (Tables 1, 7). Not extracted: Tables 4, 11, 12, 14, 15 and Figures 5-12 (colour-coded availability and scores, no printed numbers); per-model Table 16. No specific energy consumption (energy per operating hour or per unit work), opex in money, or lifetime is given anywhere in the report. Cable-electric machines are mentioned only qualitatively. Traps: efficiencies have three different scopes (engine-only peak, tractor system final-to-useful, excavator system) kept as separate process contexts; fractions (0.27, 0.85 ...) converted to %. Size segments are by engine kW / machine weight and are kept as process contexts, not technologies.
